items.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
items.summary: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

items.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
items.summary: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

items.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
items.summary: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.

items.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
items.summary: X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas.

items.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
items.summary: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

items.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available
items.summary: Google's Pixel Tag lets you track lost items with your Android device, similar to Apple's AirTag.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
items.summary: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

items.title: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
items.summary: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.

items.title: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
items.summary: Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
items.summary: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

items.summary: The remote access giant also urged its self-hosted customers to take down their own servers amid a "critical security incident," fearing the possibility of cyberattacks.

items.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
items.summary: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

items.title: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
items.summary: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.

items.title: New WhatsApp head wants to make the app easier to use, give its AI more chops
items.summary: Kunal Shah said the company wants to make voice notes, groups, stickers, and video "simpler and more expressive."
